title: Ñalngu Koolol Cakkitingol
intro: Noddaama e kollirgol doole mawngol, fedde waɗooɓe golle baawɗe tawtoreede goonga mo ɓe cikkaano, mo waylata nguurndam maɓɓe haa abada.
clues: Min teskiima e karallaagal amen, jaagorgal fenaande e fenaande.
Min noddiraa ko laamɗo ngam haɓaade luulndiiɗo jogiiɗo sawru koyndu.
Nde min njiyi goonga, min njippii e sujjande, min mbiyata ko min ngoongɗini Joomiraawo adunaaji.
Tippudi ndii ina hulɓini min e jukkungo tiiɗngo, kono min mbeltiima.
Min njeyaa ko e artuɓe goongɗinde konngol ngol caggal nde min ceedtii maande laaɓnde ndee.
En martiri ngam nuɗɗinki men, amma en laatoto arande nastugo Aljanna bee gooŋga'en.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Ɓe mbaraa leggal bardugal yeeso jamaa
outcome.answer: Ɓe mbaraa leggal bardugal yeeso jamaa

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
